new.brief: Creates a new event controller that will handle pointer motion events during drag and drop.
new.md:
Creates a new event controller that will handle pointer motion
events during drag and drop.

doc.brief: An event controller tracking the pointer during Drag-and-Drop operations.
doc.md:
An event controller tracking the pointer during Drag-and-Drop operations.

It is modeled after [`EventControllerMotion`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion) so if you
have used that, this should feel really familiar.

This controller is not able to accept drops, use [`DropTarget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget)
for that purpose.

contains_pointer.brief: Returns if a Drag-and-Drop operation is within the widget `self` or one of its children.
contains_pointer.md:
Returns if a Drag-and-Drop operation is within the widget
`self` or one of its children.

get_drop.brief: Returns the `GdkDrop` of a current Drag-and-Drop operation over the widget of `self`.
get_drop.md:
Returns the `GdkDrop` of a current Drag-and-Drop operation
over the widget of `self`.

is_pointer.brief: Returns if a Drag-and-Drop operation is within the widget `self`, not one of its children.
is_pointer.md:
Returns if a Drag-and-Drop operation is within the widget
`self`, not one of its children.

contains-pointer.brief: Whether the pointer of a Drag-and-Drop operation is in the controller's widget or a descendant.
contains-pointer.md:
Whether the pointer of a Drag-and-Drop operation is in
the controller's widget or a descendant.

See also [`DropControllerMotion:is-pointer`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropControllerMotion#property:is-pointer).

When handling crossing events, this property is updated
before [`DropControllerMotion::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropControllerMotion#event:enter), but after
[`DropControllerMotion::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropControllerMotion#event:leave) is emitted.

drop.brief: The ongoing drop operation over the controller's widget or its descendant.
drop.md:
The ongoing drop operation over the controller's widget or
its descendant.

If no drop operation is going on, this property returns `NULL`.

The event controller should not modify the `drop`, but it might
want to query its properties.

When handling crossing events, this property is updated
before [`DropControllerMotion::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropControllerMotion#event:enter), but after
[`DropControllerMotion::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropControllerMotion#event:leave) is emitted.

is-pointer.brief: Whether the pointer is in the controllers widget itself, as opposed to in a descendent widget.
is-pointer.md:
Whether the pointer is in the controllers widget itself,
as opposed to in a descendent widget.

See also [`DropControllerMotion:contains-pointer`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropControllerMotion#property:contains-pointer).

When handling crossing events, this property is updated
before [`DropControllerMotion::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropControllerMotion#event:enter), but after
[`DropControllerMotion::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropControllerMotion#event:leave) is emitted.

enter.brief: Signals that the pointer has entered the widget.
enter.md: Signals that the pointer has entered the widget.

leave.brief: Signals that the pointer has left the widget.
leave.md: Signals that the pointer has left the widget.

motion.brief: Emitted when the pointer moves inside the widget.
motion.md: Emitted when the pointer moves inside the widget.
